name: strikerapi
description: StrikerAPI brings soccer data into ChatGPT and Codex with read-only tools and workflow skills: league tables, schedules and results, lineups, match events, player stats and leaders, team ratings, head-to-head history, shot maps with expected goals, sportsbook odds and player prop lines. Sign in with your StrikerAPI account.

interface.longDescription:
StrikerAPI connects ChatGPT and Codex to soccer data from StrikerAPI. It covers the Premier League, MLS, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, the UEFA competitions and other leagues, with lineups, match events, shot maps and expected goals.

Ask for league tables, schedules and results, lineups, match events, player stats and leaders, team ratings, head-to-head history, shot maps with expected goals, sportsbook odds and player prop lines. The plugin looks the answer up with read-only tools and reports what the data says, including the season, date and source of each number.

The first time you use it, you sign in with your StrikerAPI account.

Limits: StrikerAPI is read-only. It cannot place wagers, accept or track bets, or edit your account. Odds and prop lines are shown as information about the market, not as advice. Data comes from public sources and the StrikerAPI pipeline and is not guaranteed to be error-free or current to the minute, so do not rely on it as the sole basis for financial decisions. Ratings shown are StrikerAPI's own Elo-style ratings, not official rankings. Not affiliated with any league or club.

Bundled skills teach the model how to choose the right tool for a question and how to explain results.
capabilities: Look up clubs, players and matches across many leagues
Read league tables, schedules and results
Read lineups, match events and shot maps
Read expected goals and player leaders
Read sportsbook odds and prop lines (information only)
defaultPrompt: Find Erling Haaland and show his 2025-26 stats.
Who scored the most goals in the 2025-26 Premier League?

positive.prompt: Show me the 2025-26 Premier League table.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Premier League table, 38 games played each. The top three are Arsenal 85 points (26-7-5), Manchester City 78 (23-9-6) and Manchester United 71 (20-11-7).

positive.prompt: Find Erling Haaland and show his stats for 2025-26.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Erling Haaland (player id 253989, Manchester City, forward, #9), then returns his 2025 season row: 35 appearances, 27 goals, 8 assists, 126 shots and 23.12 expected goals.

positive.prompt: What Premier League matches were played on May 24, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the final-day fixtures with scores including Brighton 0, Manchester United 3; Burnley 1, Wolves 1; and Crystal Palace 1, Arsenal 2.

positive.prompt: Who scored the most goals in the 2025-26 Premier League?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns goal leaders: Erling Haaland (Manchester City) 27, Igor Thiago (Brentford) 22, Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth and Manchester City) 17, with per-90 rates.

positive.prompt: Which clubs have the highest Elo ratings right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked club Elo ratings. On 2026-10-14 the latest ratings (as of 2026-10-12) were Manchester City 1686.2, Arsenal 1663.0, Brighton and Hove Albion 1586.5.

negative.description: Place a wager: wagering is not supported
negative.prompt: Place a $50 bet on Arsenal to win tonight.
Show me the current NFL standings.

negative.description: Account and billing change: not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 10,000 more credits and upgrade my plan to the highest tier.

review.commerce_description: StrikerAPI does not sell anything through ChatGPT. The plugin is read-only: it has no checkout, purchase, subscription or credit top-up flow.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Read-only soccer data tools with OAuth sign-in and 14 workflow skills.
